senses.gloss: (b. h. רוֹפֵף; cmp. רָפָא, רָפָה)to be loose, to vibrate, vacillate.
units: Lev. R. s. 14, end לחלב שנתון … הולך ורוֹפֵף like milk put into a dish, when you put m’so (מסוֹ) into it, it curdles and stands; if not, it will constantly vibrate; Yalk. Job 905 ומְרַפְרֵף; Gen. R. s. 14 החלב רופף; Yalk. Lev. 547; Gen. R. s. 4, end הוא מרפף (prob. to be read: מְרוֹפֵף).

<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 2:12">Tosef. Ḥull. II, 12</cite> <he>הרוֹפֶפֶת בעיניה</he> an animal that trembles (blinks) with its eyes (when being slaughtered); <cite ref="Chullin 38b">Ḥull. 38ᵇ</cite>, v. infra.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 10:1:5">Y. Erub. X, beg. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>מקום שמוחו של התינוק רופף</he>, v. <cite ref="T00952"><he>רָפַס</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 10:1:5">Ib.</cite> <he>ראה ראשו של תינוק רופף וכ׳</he> a cock saw the soft spot on an infant’s head and picked at it.
<cite ref="Tosefta Zavim 4:1">Tosef. Zab. IV, 1</cite> <he>ששני ראשיה … אמצעיתה רוֹפֶפֶת</he> the two ends of which reach to the ground, and the central part rocks (is unsupported).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 5:2:19">Y. Maas. Sh. V, 56ᵇ</cite> top <he>כל הלכה היא רופפת וכ׳</he> if the application of a law is vacillating in the courts, and you do not know what its nature is, see how the people do &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 7:5:11">Y. Peah VII, 20ᶜ</cite> top.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:7:14">Y. M. Kat. III, 83ᶜ</cite> <he>כל שבעה … היא רופפת וכ׳</he> during the seven days (of mourning in the family) the sword is drawn, up to thirty days it is held loosely (v. <cite ref="T00932"><he>רָפֶה</he></cite>), after twelve months it is returned to its sheath; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 100:7">Gen. R. s. 100</cite> <he>מִתְרַפְרֶפֶת</he>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Eruvin 54a:16">Erub. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>שרַף על הצואר</he> (Rashi <he>לצואר</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 300), v. <cite ref="P01009"><he>עֲנָק</he> II</cite>.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="T00956">same</cite>. Y. M. Kat. III, 81ᵈ top <he>והיו עמודי … מְרוֹפְפִים</he> and the columns of the meeting house shook.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 4">Gen. R. s. 4</cite>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Chullin 38b:5">Ḥull. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>אפי׳ לא ר׳ אלא גפו</he> (Ms. R. 1, 2 <he>בגפו</he>) even if the bird only flaps a wing (Var. in Ar. <he>בעינו</he> blinks with its eye, v. supra).

Gen. R. s. 2 (ref. to Gen. I, 2) כעוף הזה שהוא מְרַפְרֵף וכ׳ like a bird that flaps its wings (over its brood), and its wings touch and yet do not touch (v. רִיחוּף).—2) to flutter, be vacillating in mind.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> <he>לפי שרִפְרְפָה … קרבן מְרוּפְרָף</he> because she (at the time of travailing) wavered in her heart (lost faith; ‘Rashi’: made a half-hearted vow never to have marital intercourse again), therefore she must bring a fluttering sacrifice (a bird).
<cite ref="Tosefta Makhshirin 3:8">Tosef. Makhsh. III, 8</cite> <he>מפני שהיא מִתְרַפְרֶפֶת וכ׳</he> because it (the bunch) may be loosened, and he will tie it again.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 100">Gen. R. s. 100</cite>, v. supra.
